The count and the unit a suffix encodes

Source: R/raw_data.R
abundance_units.Rd

_10M2 is not a unit, it is a count and a unit: animals per ten square metres. Splitting them is what lets abundance be reported per one of something, which is the form anyone comparing two surveys needs.

Usage

abundance_units(suffix)

Arguments

suffix

a units suffix, with or without its leading underscore

Value

list(per=, unit=), the number the values are counted over and the unit that remains. per is 1 when the suffix carries no number.

Examples

abundance_units("_10M2")
#> $per
#> [1] 10
#> 
#> $unit
#> [1] "M2"
#> 
abundance_units("_100M3")
#> $per
#> [1] 100
#> 
#> $unit
#> [1] "M3"
#>
